The measured columns are doc/measurements.json's (2026-11-15, Apple M5 Max): the native throughput over 1 MiB, or the time of one derivation over `hmac_sha2_256`, of the fastest backend, and the smallest Emscripten program that calls the function; <<hash-measurements>> has every backend on every target. The data was measured on a loaded, shared machine, so close figures may swap at the next measurement.
